adventure/archetypes.json.archetypes/bruiser/descVi: Hits hard with decent health. Rallies the whole team to attack.
adventure/archetypes.json.archetypes/guardian/descVi: Thick health and high defense, shields the whole team.
adventure/archetypes.json.archetypes/skirmisher/descVi: Fast and crits often, but fragile.
adventure/archetypes.json.archetypes/pyromancer/descVi: Explosive damage and area burns, but brittle.
adventure/archetypes.json.archetypes/stormcaller/descVi: High speed, slows and strikes in an area.
adventure/archetypes.json.archetypes/brute/descVi: Heavy rock blows, stuns and rallies the whole team.
adventure/archetypes.json.archetypes/trickster/descVi: Shields the whole team, quick strikes, slows.

adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_ember_slash/descVi: A hot slash that deals fire damage.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_scorch_tail/descVi: A fiery tail whip that may burn the target for a few turns.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_fire_burst/descVi: Fire explodes on every enemy and may burn them.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_battle_cry/descVi: The whole team gains attack for a few turns.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_blazing_charge/descVi: Charges one enemy for very heavy damage.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_gust_strike/descVi: A quick wind strike that crits more easily.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_swift_flurry/descVi: A rapid flurry of blows on one enemy.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_tailwind/descVi: The whole team gains speed for a few turns.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_cyclone/descVi: Sweeps up every enemy and may slow them.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_razor_gale/descVi: A sharp slice of wind that crits very easily.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_rock_smash/descVi: Smashes a boulder down and may stun the target.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_stone_skin/descVi: Raises its own defense and gains a shield.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_earth_wall/descVi: The whole team gains defense for a few turns.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_quake/descVi: Shakes the ground: every enemy takes damage and may be stunned.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_boulder_toss/descVi: Hurls a huge boulder at one enemy.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_bubble_shot/descVi: A water bubble that slows the target.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_tidal_wave/descVi: A wave sweeps over every enemy.
adventure/skills.json.skills/skill_mist_veil/descVi: The whole team gets a shield that absorbs damage.

adventure/zones.json.zones/zone_forest/descVi: The first forest: five stops and a final boss. Suits teams of level 1–10.
adventure/zones.json.zones/zone_mountain/descVi: Cliffs, lava and ore golems: lots of materials for the workshop. Suits teams of level 7–14. Needs the Whispering Forest boss defeated.
adventure/zones.json.zones/zone_ruins/descVi: An old temple full of rune wisps and stone sentinels: the only place that drops Ancient Runes. Suits teams of level 12–20. Needs the Echo Mountains boss defeated.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_spring/textVi: The team drinks cool spring water and feels much better.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_herbalist/textVi: An old woman gives the team a handful of herbs and a little tonic.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_trap/textVi: Vines tangle the team's feet; everyone loses a little health (nobody falls).
adventure/zones.json.events/event_shrine/textVi: The team prays at an old shrine and learns something new.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_hot_spring/textVi: The team soaks in a hot spring and recovers.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_miner/textVi: A miner shows the team an untouched vein of ore.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_rockfall/textVi: Rocks tumble down and scrape the team (nobody falls).
adventure/zones.json.events/event_cliff_shrine/textVi: The team rests at an old altar and learns something new.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_rune_altar/textVi: The runes glow and the team understands a little more.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_ancient_cache/textVi: A small vault hides a few ancient materials.
adventure/zones.json.events/event_collapse/textVi: A corner of the temple ceiling falls; everyone loses a little health (nobody falls).

aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_goldfish/descVi: Swims in little circles with shimmering orange scales. The first fish of every tank.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_perch/descVi: A small nimble fish that likes to hide under a strand of weed.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_carp/descVi: A gentle, long-lived fish that loves to gulp bubbles at the surface.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_clownfish/descVi: Orange and white stripes, tucked inside an anemone.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_pufferfish/descVi: Puffs up like a ball whenever startled.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_angelfish/descVi: Fins long as a gown, gliding along unhurried.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_glowfish/descVi: Only comes out at night, its body glowing like a firefly under water.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_betta/descVi: Fins soft as silk, beautiful but a little proud.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_lanternfish/descVi: Carries a tiny lantern and only swims up to the surface after dark.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_seahorse/descVi: Its tail curls around seaweed; it moves in tiny steps.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_dragon_koi/descVi: Golden scales; people say it brings good luck.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_moonfish/descVi: Round and silver like the full moon, it only appears late at night.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_guppy/descVi: Tiny, with a tail like a seven-colour fan.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_neon_tetra/descVi: A neon-blue stripe down its side; loves swimming in a group.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_catfish/descVi: Whiskers like a moustache; forever rummaging on the bottom.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_loach/descVi: Long and wiggly, it slips through any gap.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_gourami/descVi: Honey-gold, feeling its way with two long feelers.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_butterflyfish/descVi: Flat and lemon-yellow, with a fake eye-spot near the tail.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_boxfish/descVi: Square like a polka-dot gift box; waddles along.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_blue_tang/descVi: Royal blue with a yellow tail; always forgets the way home.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_discus/descVi: Round and flat like a painted plate.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_lionfish/descVi: Fins fanned like a lion’s mane; grand but gentle.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_parrotfish/descVi: A beak like a parrot’s; crunches on coral.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_jellyfish/descVi: Pulses gently; only rises at night.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_octopus/descVi: Eight curious arms; jets off with a puff of water.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_sea_turtle/descVi: Paddles slowly with four flippers; lives a very long time.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_manta/descVi: Great wings that glide as if flying underwater.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_arowana/descVi: Big gleaming gold scales that bring good luck.
aquarium/fish.json.fish/fish_dolphin/descVi: Clever and loves to leap. Only ever bred.

breeding/rumors.json.recipeTemplates/0: I hear a {rarity} pig is only born when {parentA} meets {parentB}...
breeding/rumors.json.recipeTemplates/1: Folks say pairing {parentA} with {parentB} does something strange. The child belongs to the {rarity} group, and they say it looks {theme}.
breeding/rumors.json.recipeTemplates/2: Last night I dreamed {parentA} and {parentB} had a {rarity} piglet together. I wonder if it's an omen?
breeding/rumors.json.recipeTemplates/3: Someone claims to have seen a {rarity} pig of the {theme} kind in a pen over there, with {parentA} and {parentB} as parents. I'm not sure, though.
breeding/rumors.json.noNews/0: No new rumors today. Try pairing a few unusual couples.
breeding/rumors.json.noNews/1: I've told you every rumor I know; now it's your turn to explore.
breeding/rumors.json.tips/0: A pig with a rare trait is worth keeping for breeding; the trait passes to the next generation.
breeding/rumors.json.tips/1: Care for a pig up to 5 hearts and its hidden trait will show.
breeding/rumors.json.tips/2: Breeding for ages without a rare one? Be patient; luck builds up for you.
breeding/rumors.json.tips/3: Two pigs of the same family or similar look usually get along better.
breeding/rumors.json.tips/4: Sometimes a mutation happens: the child has a trait neither parent has.

breeding/traits.json.traits/trait_sweet/descVi: Bond grows 25% more each time you care for it.
breeding/traits.json.traits/trait_cheerful/descVi: Bond grows 15% more and it grows 5% faster.
breeding/traits.json.traits/trait_lucky_star/descVi: A pair with this one mutates 3 percentage points more easily.
breeding/traits.json.traits/trait_cuddly/descVi: Bond grows one and a half times as much.
breeding/traits.json.traits/trait_ancient_blood/descVi: Mutates 6 percentage points more easily and the price is 20% higher.
breeding/traits.json.traits/trait_spirit_touch/descVi: Bond grows twice as much, and it grows 10% faster.

garden/balance.json.buildings/mill/descVi: Grinds corn, wheat and carrots into food for the pigs.
garden/balance.json.buildings/composter/descVi: Composts pig manure and grass into fertilizer.

shared/festivals.json.festivals/fest_harvest/descVi: A bumper crop! Harvest plants and deliver orders to earn Festival Tokens.
shared/festivals.json.festivals/fest_fish/descVi: The whole pier heads out! Catch fish and change the tank water to earn Festival Tokens.
shared/festivals.json.festivals/fest_flower/descVi: The clouds are in bloom! Pick flowers and brew potions to earn Festival Tokens.
shared/festivals.json.festivals/fest_pig/descVi: The whole pen is buzzing! Pet pigs, hatch eggs and ship pigs out to earn Festival Tokens.

shared/merchant.json.greetingVi: Hello there! I roam everywhere trading goods. I'm stopping by the Plaza for a little while; do you have anything I need?
shared/merchant.json.linesVi/0: The road is long, so I pay more generously than the order board, you know.
shared/merchant.json.linesVi/1: I'm looking for goods for faraway customers; bring me whatever you have.
shared/merchant.json.linesVi/2: I'm leaving tomorrow, so whatever is done is done!
shared/merchant.json.linesVi/3: They say the market favors one group of goods today; have a look at the Market.

shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/greetingVi: Hello! I'm Mo, I look after this farm. Ask me anything you need.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/topics/feed/textVi: Hungry pigs stop growing and fall sick easily. Pour food into the trough: pigs eat by themselves when hungry. With premium food or grass from Sobi Garden you can feed by hand to make a pig happier.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/topics/care/textVi: Wash the pigs, clear manure at the Well, and pet them every day (up to 2 times each). Every pig has a favorite food: feed it the right one for extra bond hearts. From 3 hearts, a pig has a chance to be one quality tier higher when shipped out.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/topics/sick/textVi: Pigs left hungry or dirty for long fall sick easily. After 2 days sick they become critical, after 3 days they do not survive, but the game always warns early. Medicine cures them at once.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/topics/purpose/textVi: Once a pig is grown you choose its purpose: Shipping to sell, Breeding for breeding, or Pet to love (not sold, and it makes the whole pen happier). You can change your mind any time.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/topics/orders/textVi: The Plaza board wants produce and materials, with bigger rewards than selling one by one. The farm's own orders need exactly the right kind of pig. Daily goals are gentle and optional.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/topics/market/textVi: Each day a few groups of goods fetch more and one group drops. Open the Market in the Menu to see what sells best today.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_farmer/topics/decor/textVi: Placed decor makes the pigs happier; stored away it adds nothing. Each piece has a few spots to move between.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_gardener/greetingVi: Quack! I'm Can, the gardening specialist here. Ask me anything.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_gardener/topics/plant/textVi: Pick a seed, then click an empty plot to sow. A dry plant grows at half speed: water by hand (lasts 3 hours) or buy a Sprinkler so the garden waters itself.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_gardener/topics/ripe/textVi: Pick ripe plants early: left over 48 hours they wilt and lose half the yield. The game keeps counting time while your computer is off.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_gardener/topics/fertilizer/text: Clear pig manure on the Farm and compost it with grass in the Composter to make fertilizer. Apply it so plants grow faster and give extra yield.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_gardener/topics/mill/textVi: Corn, wheat and carrots are ground into pig food (cheaper than buying) and premium food (filling, makes pigs happy). The Mill runs in real time, and you can make several batches at once.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_gardener/topics/loop/textVi: Pigs give manure, manure becomes fertilizer, fertilizer feeds the plants, plants become food for the pigs. Carrots and corn are also favorite foods of the pigs, and goods for the Order Board.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_breeder/greetingVi: Hello! I'm Lai, I keep an eye on breeding matters. I'll share any news, but a story is only fun when told by halves.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_breeder/topics/traits/textVi: Each pig carries up to 3 traits and passes them to its young half and half. Sometimes a child is born with a rare trait neither parent has: that is a mutation.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_breeder/topics/hidden/textVi: Rare traits are sometimes hidden. Care for the pig up to 5 hearts and it shows. Until then it still passes to the next generation, so do not rush to sell the young of a precious line.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_breeder/topics/luck/textVi: If breeding keeps failing to give a rare pig, luck builds up and next time is easier. Once a rare pig is born, luck starts over.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_breeder/topics/pedigree/textVi: Open the pig panel and press Pedigree to see a pig's parents and grandparents. First-generation pigs have no pedigree yet.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_breeder/topics/codex/textVi: In the Collection book, the question-mark slots are breeds you have not met. A slot shows the rarity and family of the breed, enough to guess which parents to try.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_fisher/greetingVi: Cluck... Hello! I'm Dreamy, I look after this fish tank and fishing pier.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_fisher/topics/fishing/textVi: Go to the pier, press Fish, then press at the moment the float touches the green zone. The more accurate you are, the better your chance of rare fish. The rod rests 2 minutes between casts. Some fish only bite at night.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_fisher/topics/tank/textVi: Hungry fish stop growing and cloudy water makes them sick. Feed with fish food (ground from potatoes at the Garden Mill), change the water when it clouds, and pet the fish so they get used to you.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_fisher/topics/release/textVi: Caught fish stay in the bag. Release them into the tank to raise them (raised fish sell for much more), or sell them right away, or keep them for orders and the Codex.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_fisher/topics/scales/textVi: Grown fish shed scales over time, and you collect them in the tank. Pearls sit inside pearl oysters that now and then bite your line. Both are used to upgrade the tank and the Garden's Sprinkler.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_fisher/topics/breed/textVi: Two fish of the same species, one male and one female, grown and healthy, produce an egg. The egg hatches into fry that inherit their parents' traits. Only some species can breed.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_alchemist/greetingVi: Hoot hoot... Hello! I'm Owl the Alchemist, keeper of this flower garden and the cauldron in the clouds.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_alchemist/topics/water/textVi: The Cloud Spring drips out Pure Water and stops when full, so remember to collect it. Flowers watered with it grow four times faster than with ordinary watering. Upgrade the spring to make it flow faster and hold more.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_alchemist/topics/flowers/textVi: Common flowers (Cloud Daisy, Dandelion) grow fast and sell easily. Rare flowers (Rainbow Rose, Star Orchid) grow slowly and yield little, but are precious ingredients for potions and for breeding.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_alchemist/topics/night/textVi: Moon Lily and Dream Bell bloom best at night: picked after dark you get double the flowers. Picking by day still works, just for less.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_alchemist/topics/potions/textVi: The cauldron in the corner of the garden brews potions from flowers and Pure Water. A Healing Potion cures a sick pig or fish (even in critical condition) and lifts its mood. A Cheer Potion only lifts mood. Battle Potions are saved for the adventure.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_alchemist/topics/mutation/textV: When breeding you can add a rare flower: the mutation chance rises and the young are likelier to get a precious trait. Rainbow Rose and Star Orchid are strongest.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_knight/greetingVi: Oink oink! Hello, I am the Knight Pig. The Whispering Forest is waiting for brave warriors!
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_knight/topics/start/textVi: Take my starter pig from the board. To bring another pig or fish along, let it grow, then choose the "Adventure" purpose in its info panel.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_knight/topics/team/textVi: Each trip takes up to 3 companions, each costing 30 adventure energy. Energy recovers by itself in real time. A sick or exhausted one cannot go yet.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_knight/topics/battle/textVi: The faster one strikes first. Fire beats Wind, Wind beats Earth, Earth beats Water, Water beats Fire: a super effective hit is half again as strong. Skills cost battle energy and need a rest between uses. There is an Auto button and x2 speed if you want to watch faster.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_knight/topics/gear/textVi: Each companion wears a weapon, an armor and a charm. Gear drops from chests and wild beasts; rare pieces are far stronger.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_knight/topics/lose/textVi: Nobody is lost! The team is only exhausted for 4 real hours. Loot already collected is kept. You can also retreat between two stops.
shared/npcs.json.npcs/npc_knight/topics/bond/textVi: The closer a companion is to you (more hearts), the stronger it is on adventures. Pet them and feed their favorite food often.

shared/shop.json.products/FOOD_BASIC/descVi: Restores 50 fullness. Also the unit poured into the trough.

shared/tech.json.techs/tech_workshop/descVi: The Mill, Composter and Cauldron work faster.
shared/tech.json.techs/tech_batch/descVi: More batches at a time in the Mill, Composter and Cauldron.
shared/tech.json.techs/tech_kitchen/descVi: Unlocks ration recipes to carry on adventures and adds room to carry them.
